NEW YORK, Sept. 11 (Xinhua) -- The U.S. Index of Consumer Sentiment slipped to 47.8 in September 2026, according to a preliminary reading released Friday by the University of Michigan (UM) Surveys of Consumers, down from the final reading of 51.7 in August 2026 and from the final reading of 55.1 in September 2025.

This is the second consecutive month consumer sentiment has receded. [...] U.S. consumer sentiment slips in September, inflation expectations rise-Xinhua

# US Consumer Sentiment Falls as Inflation Expectations Rise

The University of Michigan’s consumer sentiment index fell to 47.8 in early September 2026, down for a second consecutive month and well below market expectations of 51.0, according to the preliminary estimate.

It was the weakest reading since May’s record low.
